place a version or a URL is written. D00 T01 §1 owns the format, D00 T01 §6
Every sha256 was taken from a real download on 2026-09-17 and independently
cross-checked against the digest GitHub records for the same asset. A pin
without a hash is reproducible only until a release is re-cut in place.

components.name: llvm-mingw
components.note: Self-contained UCRT-targeting archive. Carries its own headers and import libraries, so no Windows SDK is needed and no licence question arises. Targets the MinGW-w64 environment, not the MSVC ABI.
